overall: The AG found no violation: the Board lawfully met in person at a physically accessible town hall room under Chapter 20, § 20(b), and was not required to provide remote access or a recording or transcript.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board violated the OML by holding its June 29 meeting at a physical location without also providing remote access.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it met in person on June 29 and did not also provide remote access to the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board violated the OML by not posting a recording or full transcript of the June 29 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Moreover, the Board was not required to make an audio or video recording of the meeting.
